verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine, so support for diverse CPU architectures is a fair question for it. The evidence lists only iOS, Android, Windows (C++ + Vulkan) and macOS targets and never mentions PowerPC or any other non-x86/ARM CPU. The pluggable backend facade, with a reserved CUDA slot, is only a developer building block, not shipped support for other architectures.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
